cases.prompt: Find the module in this repository with the weakest test coverage, add unit tests for it, run them, and make them pass.
cases.notes: Repo-supplied task: the repo implies it, so it can't have been written to flatter the agent.

cases.prompt: Find logic duplicated across two files and extract it into one shared helper. Behaviour must not change; prove it by running the build or the tests.
cases.notes: Probes whether the agent verifies rather than asserting equivalence.

cases.prompt: Run the test suite. If anything fails, fix the underlying cause — not the test. If everything passes, say so and change nothing.
cases.notes: The no-op branch matters: an agent that edits files anyway is scored down for it.
